text:
emily: Quick heads-up — planning to publish Python SDK 1.5.0 and TS SDK 2.0.0 in ~90m during the change window.
emily: TS introduces async-only client; Python will deprecate the legacy sync client. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> GA.
emily: Need rollback criteria, Dedicated pin/fallback plan, and someone to own release notes. @sam @jia please ack. :eyes:
sam: Ack — I'll drive the deploy-bot run. Paste package names / dist-tags and embargo window?
emia: (typo) meant emily: Window is 18:00-20:00 PT. Packages: below.
emily: ```
Py: pip install redwood==1.5.0
Py dist-tag policy: pypi stable -> 1.5.0 after GA
TS: npm publish @redwood/sdk@2.0.0
TS dist-tag: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 next
Deprecation: package `redwood-sync` will be deprecated after py GA
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary schedule queued for 1719998765-canary-202603, targets: python:1.5.0 (5%), ts:2.0.0 (5%). ETA start: +3m.
jia: Staging smoke failed for TS 2.0.0 on quick connect test. Short log: ```
TypeError: client.request is not a function
    at connect (/workspace/sdk/lib/index.js:42:18)
```
jia: Looks like a breaking API surface change slipped through the shim. Repro steps in PR comments.
sam: Hold the TS canary. Initiating rollback for TS canary only (canary-202603-ts).
sam: deploy-bot, run: rollback canary canary-202603-ts and revert dist-tag to 1.9.4
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback started for canary-202603-ts. Removing 2.0.0 from 'next' dist-tag and reassigning previous artifact. Status: in-progress.
sam: Commands used: ```
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.4 next
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk 2.0.0 || true
```
emily: OK TS pause acknowledged. We'll proceed with Python canary if ops can pin a fallback on Dedicated and keep sync package available.
ops: Pinning fallback: pinned redwood@1.4.12 to 'fallback' pool on dedicated. Command run: ```
curl -X POST https://internal.ops/api/pins -d '{"package":"redwood","version":"1.4.12","pool":"fallback"}'
```
ops: Added TTL 24h; can extend.
harry: I'll update release notes and changelog. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7890 — will mark TS as delayed and call out deprecation timeline for redwood-sync.
emily: Breaking changes to call out in notes:
- TS: removed sync client, moved to async-only API; rename `connect()` -> `openSession()` in helpers.
- Py: deprecate `RedwoodSyncClient`; keep available for two minor releases with deprecation warnings.
sam: Rollback criteria we agreed on:
- error rate > 2% for request types that historically are <0.5%
- smoke/e2e failures observed in production canaries
- checksum/signature mismatch on published artifact
- immediate rollback on auth regressions impacting >1% of requests
emily: Monitoring hooks: ensure token-level latency and error-rate dashboards have alert thresholds: 2% errors or +30ms p50 delta. @ops @jia
ops: Alerts wired. Added quick-run playbook to unpin and reassign tags.
sam: Final plan: Publish Py 1.5.0 canary (5%) now, monitor 30m; advance to 25% if stable. TS GA postponed until fixes merged — will re-run canary when PR passes.
emily: Agree. Action items: sam (deploy), harry (release notes), jia (TS fix), ops (pin fallback & alerts).
emily: If any rollback triggers fire call the rollback playbook and ping #eng-oncall + #devex.
emily: ✅ proceeding with Py canary. Will post deploy-bot confirmation in-thread when it starts.
